annotations.title: Institutional buying and selling by quarter

description: Returns what institutional managers did with the tracked AI and semiconductor stocks in one quarter, from their Form 13F filings: the net flow of managers present at both quarters (stock pickers apart), by segment; the companies most bought and sold; the largest named moves; new big positions; full exits; and whose declared picks returned most. Default: the latest quarter past its 13F deadline; a quarter still being filed returns its first filers (`wave`). A 13F shows long positions at quarter end, not current holdings; `method` says how flows are counted. Use it when the user asks what funds bought or sold in a quarter; for one fund, get_holders; for one company, get_ownership.
name: get_fund_flows
title: Institutional buying and selling by quarter
